title: DAY 16/90
FLYWHEELS
scenes.sub: Theory of Machines: forces in motion
scenes.voice: Day sixteen of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, ninety three days to go. Today, machines start storing energy: linkages and flywheels.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is theory of machines. Our topic: dynamics of linkages, turning moment diagrams, and flywheels.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover inertia forces in a slider crank, turning moment diagrams, maximum fluctuation of energy, and how to size a flywheel.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Maximum fluctuation of energy equals I omega squared times C s, where C s is the coefficient of fluctuation of speed. Find delta E from the turning moment diagram first.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the free practice PDF on Telegram now. The topic test opens at seven and closes at nine P. M., inside our one rupee challenge course.
